title: Boundaries of Retail Quantitative Trading on Prediction Markets: A Multi-Mechanism Empirical Retrospective
description: Release package for Paper 2 from Abel AI Lab. The artifact contains the manuscript, references, cross-campaign aggregate data, ancillary registries, a release-local paper eval, and preserved engineering primitives from a terminated Path C campaign. Claims are scoped to a single-lab, single-period retrospective of LLM-assisted retail prediction-market trading campaigns.
notes: Metadata for Zenodo DOI registration after the GitHub repository is public and a release tag is created. arXiv preprint identifier added when assigned.
